tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.u.en: Right-click the center of a Soul Pentacle (tier 1 or higher) to call a Matrix Specter
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.u.zh: 拿着它右键一档以上灵魂五芒星的中心块，召出一只矩阵之影

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.en: You need at least %s matrix damage
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.zh: 你身上要有至少 %s 点矩阵损伤

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.t.en: Up to %1$s of it moves into the Specter; the pentacle's pillars pay %2$s effective ESPE per point
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.t.zh: 最多 %1$s 点会转进它的身体，五芒星的柱子每点付 %2$s 有效 ESPE

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.t.en: Up to %s of it moves into the Specter; the pentacle's pillars pay no ESPE for it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.t.zh: 最多 %s 点会转进它的身体，五芒星的柱子不用付 ESPE

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.r.en: Defeat it and that damage is gone. If the fight fails, everything comes back
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.r.zh: 打倒它，转进去的损伤就没了；没打成的话，损伤、ESPE 和这张符都原样退回

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.o.en: %s matrix damage moved into the Specter. Defeat it to be rid of it
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.o.zh: 你把 %s 点矩阵损伤转给了它。打倒它，这些损伤就没了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.g.en: The conduit only works in Survival or Adventure
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.g.zh: 只有生存和冒险模式能用导流符

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.p.zh: 和平难度下召不出矩阵之影

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.en: Use it on the center of a Soul Pentacle
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.zh: 要点在灵魂五芒星的中心块上

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.t.en: This pentacle is below tier 1. Finish the structure first
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.t.zh: 这座五芒星还不到一档，先把结构补全

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.d.en: You may not use this pentacle here
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.d.zh: 你没有权限在这里动这座五芒星

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.en: You carry %s matrix damage; the conduit needs %s
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.zh: 你身上只有 %s 点矩阵损伤，要 %s 点才够转

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.o.en: A Matrix Specter or Calamity Heart is already within %s blocks
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.o.zh: %s 格内已经有一只矩阵之影或天灾之心了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.en: The pillars are %s effective ESPE short (this needs %s)
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.n.zh: 柱子里的 ESPE 不够：还差 %s 点有效 ESPE（一共要 %s）

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.b.en: There is no room for it here. Clear a 3-block-tall space over or around the pentacle
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.b.zh: 这里站不下它：在五芒星上方或旁边清出 3 格高的空地

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.s.en: The Specter failed to appear. Nothing was used up
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_conduit.s.zh: 矩阵之影没能出现，什么都没扣

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.pha.en: Body phase: watch its fists and the shadow under your feet
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.pha.zh: 身相：小心它的拳头，还有你脚下的阴影

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.pha.en: Mind phase: the real one has a lit grid on its chest
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.pha.zh: 心相：胸口矩阵格亮着的才是真身

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.pha.en: Matrix phase: spread out, and raise your shield when it pulls
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.pha.zh: 矩阵相：分散站开，它往回拉时举起盾牌

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.gri.en: It has you. Hit it once to break free
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.gri.zh: 你被它抓住了：打它一下就能挣开

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.mir.en: Mirror images! Look for the lit chest grid
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.mir.zh: 镜影出现了：找胸口矩阵格亮着的那个

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.spi.en: A Mind Spike shields it. Break the spike
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.spi.zh: 心智钉在替它挡伤害，先把钉子打掉

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.whi.en: Something whispers to you. Look away from it
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.whi.zh: 有声音在你耳边低语……别看它

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.con.en: It is pulling everything in. Sneak to resist, block to survive the burst
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.con.zh: 它在把所有人往身边拉：潜行能少被拉一半，举盾挡得住最后那一下

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fad.en: The Matrix Specter is fading away

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.def.en: The Matrix Specter dissolves, and the damage it carried goes with it
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.def.zh: 矩阵之影散成了碎片，它带走的矩阵损伤也跟着没了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.sum.en: Get back to the pentacle within %s seconds or the Specter will fade
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.sum.zh: %s 秒内回到五芒星附近，不然矩阵之影会散去

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.en: %s matrix damage came back to you, along with the conduit and the ESPE
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.zh: %s 点矩阵损伤还给了你，导流符和预扣的 ESPE 也退回了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.en: %s matrix damage and the conduit came back to you. ESPE the pillars can't hold right now goes back a little later
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.zh: %s 点矩阵损伤和导流符还给了你。柱子一时装不下的 ESPE，过一会儿再往里退

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.en: %s matrix damage came back to you and the ESPE went back to the pillars. You get the conduit back when you respawn
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.zh: %s 点矩阵损伤还给了你，预扣的 ESPE 退回了柱子，导流符等你重生时还你

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.en: %s matrix damage came back to you, and you get the conduit back when you respawn. ESPE the pillars can't hold right now goes back a little later
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.zh: %s 点矩阵损伤还给了你，导流符等你重生时还你。柱子一时装不下的 ESPE，过一会儿再往里退

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.en: Another %s would have gone over your matrix damage cap, so it was not returned
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.zh: 另有 %s 点会超出矩阵损伤上限，没有还给你

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.con.en: %s Matrix Conduit(s) from the faded Specter came back to you
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.con.zh: 矩阵之影散去时押着的 %s 张导流符还给了你

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.en: While you were away your Matrix Specter faded: %s matrix damage and %s conduit(s) came back to you
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.ref.zh: 你不在的时候矩阵之影散了：%s 点矩阵损伤和 %s 张导流符还给了你

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: You fell, and your Matrix Specter fades
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 你倒下了，矩阵之影随之散去

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: You left, and your Matrix Specter fades
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 你离开了，矩阵之影随之散去

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: You left this world, and your Matrix Specter fades
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 你离开了这个世界，矩阵之影随之散去

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: You stayed away too long, and your Matrix Specter fades
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 你离开得太久，矩阵之影散去了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: No one was left to fight it, and your Matrix Specter fades
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 没人跟它打了，矩阵之影散去了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: The world turned Peaceful, and your Matrix Specter fades
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 难度变成了和平，矩阵之影散去了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: Your Matrix Specter vanished without anyone defeating it
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 矩阵之影没被谁打倒就消失了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.en: Your Matrix Specter was wiped from the world
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_shade.fai.zh: 矩阵之影被从世界上抹掉了
